subject: OrchidAI - request to stretch evaluation window and pricing options
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orchidai.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — extra runway for the POC?

Hi David,

Thanks again for the support during last week's throughput run. We pushed a larger workload overnight and surfaced a couple of stability blips around KV-cache warmup. The team has a mitigation path but we need a little more time to validate end-to-end on our side.

Can you outline what options Redwood can offer to stretch the current time-boxed evaluation by ~3 weeks? Specifically:
- Cost to extend the hosted POC as-is (per-token or flat top-up)
- A credits alternative (one-time bucket we draw from)
- Any pathway to convert to a small committed slot (monthly) while retaining a discounted trial window

I attached the telemetry we collected (orchidai_telemetry.csv) — helps explain the warmup behavior. Procurement may loop in a formal request if needed.

Appreciate a quick run of options this week so we can plan engineering validation.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of ML Platforms
OrchidAI

Attachment: orchidai_telemetry.csv (csv)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-01T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — extra runway for the POC?

Kimberly / Rishi — forwarding Lena's note. TL;DR: OrchidAI hit an edge in the KV warmup and wants +3 weeks to finish validation. They asked for three alternatives (extension cost, credits, convert-to-commit).

My suggested pricing options to present (internal draft):
1) Timebox extension (3 weeks): flat add-on of $6,000 (covers hosting and burst) — offered at ~30% off list per-day token estimate.
2) Credit bucket: $4,000 refundable credits (consumable against API calls during extended window).
3) Conversion path: 30% credit on first month if they sign a 6-month Dedicated pilot within 30 days of extension.

Please review and flag what you can authorize. If we need to go deeper on discount (>=40%), Rishi, we'll need finance sign-off + a short note from sales leadership. I'm attaching a quick pricing calc (david_internal_pricing.xlsx).

Goal: get back to Lena with a clean set of 2 options (one conservative, one conversion-led) by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
David
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: david_internal_pricing.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick ask — extra runway for the POC?

David — I like the structure. A couple of tweaks to keep runway but protect ACV: 

- Option A (low friction): 2-week extension + $2,000 credit applied to usage. This minimizes financial exposure and forces quicker decisioning.
- Option B (conversion incentive): 3-week extension at 25% discount on the extension fee (so ~$4,500) if they agree to a 12-month Dedicated pilot (small pool, 1 GPU equivalent) within 45 days. Include a short MOU to capture intent — I'll draft.

If they push for a straight 3-week extension without conversion terms we should cap it at $5,500. Anything beyond that needs Rishi + one of us to approve.

Also recommend we include a short success milestone: if they hit the KV warmup target (metrics in their telemetry) within the extended window we will credit 50% of the extension fee back against first invoice if they convert. That's an extra incentive.

I'll prepare the MOU stub and a DocuSign placeholder.

-Kimberly
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (will attach MOU stub in reply)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-07T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick ask — extra runway for the POC?

Kimberly / David — finance perspective: we can approve up to $3,500 equivalent in credits/discount without escalating to CRO for deals under $75k ACV. Anything that increases upfront liability (refundable credits or >30% discount) needs a short rationale and CRO sign-off.

If you frame Option B as conversion-led (12-month commit) with a partial credit-back upon success, that materially reduces risk and I can sign off on the 25% concession for the extension fee.

Request: when you present to the customer, capture a single checkbox in the MOU indicating conversion intent and an approximate committed GPU/month baseline. That will be our trigger to convert the credit into deferred revenue treatment.

-Rishi
Finance — Revenue Ops

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orchidai.com>, procurement@orchidai.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: OrchardAI POC — extension options and next steps

Hi Lena — thanks for sending the telemetry. We've reviewed it and outlined two pathways that keep your validation on track while balancing cost and conversion risk. Sorry for the slight delay; wanted to confirm internal approvals.

Option 1 — Fast extension (low friction)
- 2-week hosted extension + $2,000 usage credit applied to the extended window
- No conversion requirement
- Deliverable: extension addendum to the existing POC statement of work (attached)
- Ideal if you need the shortest timeline and minimal paperwork.

Option 2 — Conversion-forward (lower net spend if you convert)
- 3-week extension with a $4,500 invoice (25% discount applied)
- If OrchidAI signs a 12-month Dedicated pilot within 45 days, we will credit 50% of the extension fee back against month 1 invoice (credit applied upon successful KV warmup metric)
- Requires a signed MOU indicating conversion intent and approximate committed capacity

Finance note: Redwood Finance has pre-approved the Option 2 concession structure under standard conversion triggers. If you need a larger one-off credit, we can escalate but prefer the conversion path.

Next steps:
- Please reply with which option you prefer and a contact for procurement to receive the addendum/MOU.
- If you prefer Option 2 we will send the DocuSign MOU + short technical success criteria to validate the credit-back.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week to walk through the MOU and timeline.

Best regards,
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David Kim | david_kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: OrchidAI_MOU_stub.pdf (pdf)
